topics.label: Welcome and framing of the complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: Introduces the lecture and frames complement within the broader study of immunology.

topics.label: Core principles, nomenclature, and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: Establishes the foundational architecture of the complement cascade, its naming rules, and the central role of C3 cleavage.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: Details how upstream recognition pathways converge on convertase assembly to reach the threshold for complement activation on pathogen surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: Explains the downstream processes through which activated complement targets and eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of complement activation on host cells
topics.groupedBecause: Describes the regulatory proteins that protect host cells from accidental complement activation and damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: Examines the distinct clinical manifestations and disease risks resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: Analyzes the molecular mechanisms pathogens employ to subvert and evade complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of adaptive immunity
topics.groupedBecause: Concludes the complement lecture and previews the upcoming topic on adaptive immunity.
